data.name: Amata Green Consulting, SL (Amata Green)
data.description: Amata Green is a Spain-based biochar startup planning a production facility in Jaén, Andalucía that would convert olive mill and olive-farming waste into biochar for agricultural soil application and carbon removal credits. The company has been construction-ready for several years pending investment funding, and sells small quantities of its "Eco-Mix" biochar product in the meantime.
